about: Every asset Fall Line ships, where it comes from and under what licence. Every sound is synthesized, and the mountain, the trees, the wildlife, the course's marks and the skier's outfit are geometry built by code at run time; the models below are made in Blender off the game's own data. The third-party rows are the typefaces on the signs, the real mountains' heights and their ski areas, the world map and the X-ray cam's body, each under its own licence and credited as it asks. A new kind of asset, or a new generator, changes this file in the same commit.
